newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT says no decision yet on int'l services unit.
newsitem.headline: NTT says no decision yet on int'l services unit.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp said on Wednesday it has not yet decided whether it will form a new unit for international services.
A report in the Nikkan Kogyo Shimbun newspaper said NTT would form a wholly owned subsidiary in September to launch international services.
But an NTT spokesman said: "We may use one of our subsidiaries to launch international services. Everything is up in the air."
NTT, whose business is currently limited to domestic services, will be allowed to embark on international services after a revision of the law governing its operations, expected to be made in June.
A draft revision stipulates that NTT be allowed to enter international services through its unit.
